messages:
alex: Opening a short action thread from the PM postmortem. We need tight owners for quota backstops, scheduler params, headroom forecasts, and recurrence detection. Goal: concrete PRs + test plan this sprint.
tanya: I can own quota/backstop. Action items I see: vendor reserved capacity options, emergency backstop policy (per-customer), and cost impact calc. Will draft a policy doc.
julian: I'll take scheduler tuning. Plan: run a 48h soak in staging with conservative eviction changes + adaptive batching. I want to compare p50/p95/p99 and cost per 1M tokens.
nora: Headroom forecasting is mine. I'll produce a 6-week rolling forecast and a simple surge-model that predicts likely windows (timezone + product events). Also will add a small synthetic-load harness to simulate nightly spikes.
ben: I'll handle detection + alerting. Proposal: two new signals - sustained_util (5m) -> page, and transient_burst (1m) -> channel. Also add an automated incident digest that correlates GPU spikes with scheduler rebalances.
ci-cadet: ci-bot: Canary job queued: autoscale-config-v2 -> cluster-beta. Watch logs at https://ci.redwood/jobs/5521.
alex: For clarity let's split tasks and deadlines now. Also include acceptance checks (staging pass, canary stable for 24h, cost delta <12%).
tanya: Draft ownership + due dates: quota/backstop doc + vendor options - Tanya - 2026-04-06. I'll include a fallback quota that kicks in when cluster headroom < 8% for 10m.
julian: Scheduler tuning PR - Julian - 2026-03-31. Staging soak starts 2026-03-29 02:00 UTC. I'll include this override snippet in the PR and the test harness:```
# scheduler overrides for soak
scheduler.work_fraction=0.9
scheduler.eviction_threshold=0.7
adaptive_batch.enabled=true
adaptive_batch.target_ms=10
```
nora: Headroom forecast + surge-sim harness - Nora - 2026-04-02. I'll add docs to /runbooks/headroom-forecast and a graph compare for last 3 months vs forecast.
ben: Alerts + digest implementation - Ben - 2026-03-30. Prom rules I'll add: `sum by(cluster) (gpu_util) / sum by(cluster) (gpu_cap) > 0.82 for 5m` and a separate recording rule for 1m spikes. Will also attach a checklist for oncall responders.
alex: Also we need a recurring test that simulates the pattern we saw twice in last fortnight (approx 03:00 UTC saw sudden request fanout). Suggest weekly simulated-fanout job in staging that exercises autoscaler. Who can pair on that?
julian: I can pair with Nora on the sim harness. We'll make it parameterized so it can run as a stress test or smoke.
tanya: Procurement pinged. I'll confirm 2 vendor options: 1) short-term reserved burst blocks, 2) soft quota increase with automatic cost alert. Will attach pricing scenarios to the doc.
ci-cadet: deploy-bot: Canary started: autoscale-config-v2 -> cluster-beta (canary-id: cb-332). Monitoring hooks live.
ben: Also adding a small regression guard: any scheduler change must include a 10-minute synthetic trace that validates KV cache warmup and end-to-end p99 under load. I'll put the test template in the PR checklist.
alex: Summary table we'll use in the GH project (I will create and invite owners):
- quota/backstop: Tanya - due 2026-04-06 - accept: policy doc + vendor quotes + fallback quota configured in staging
- scheduler tuning: Julian - due 2026-03-31 - accept: staging soak report + canary 24h stability + perf table
- headroom forecasting & sim: Nora - due 2026-04-02 - accept: forecast notebook + surge-sim harness + runbook update
- alerts & digest: Ben - due 2026-03-30 - accept: Prom rules + runbook + alert tests wired to test pager
- weekly sim job: Julian+Nora - infra task - recurring on Mondays 03:00 UTC
- oncall FAQ: Alex - due 2026-03-29 - accept: short doc on when to flip to reserved capacity vs backstop quota

alex: Quick ask: everyone add one realistic acceptance test to their PR and link to the GH card. We'll treat the canary stability window as critical gate.
tanya: Noted, will add a cost-limited scenario and a vendor fallback smoke test.
julian: Staging soak window scheduled, I'll post results and the perf numbers as a small table.
ben: I'll implement alerting in a feature branch and trigger a test page to the test rotation once it's ready.
ora: I'll version the forecast and make a short explainer for ops showing expected headroom by region.
alex: Thanks all. If no objections I'll create the project board now and assign cards. Follow-ups: make sure one EM or PM is cc'd on each card. Closing - will drop the GH link here when ready.
